## Requirements: reviewed explicit Staging integration

This is the **one-time, manually reviewed conflict-resolution bridge** for #2953. It is not a controller-owned automatic merge and cannot itself satisfy #2953 SC-03.
- Planned main SHA: `860cd4b5355dcbc850abe42958d296466158e5ad`
- Planned staging SHA: `5f35446f01ab07d8460f3ee3d28906324ed83085`
- Two-parent candidate SHA: `09b2acd85c392383ad22f0931ddfbd7617b4e242` (staging first, main second)
- Source Git merge-base: `8352d3abb6f3c73b07db2fed1357566aa17f74b2`
- Scope: 162 main-only file deltas, 15 reviewed overlapping paths, one CLI identity parity fix; no force-push, no direct staging write
- Critical decisions: retain modular CLI commands under staging, discard legacy `agent.rs`/`config.rs` duplicates after porting identity resolution; preserve staged/unstaged Git diff semantics, selection/media Blob lifecycle and browser fixture behavior
- This explicit merge candidate is not native `git merge-tree` output. Independent Rust/Web/Browser/Issue checks must validate the resulting tree before any protected merge.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Exact two-parent integration PR passes canonical Quality, Case Smoke and Issue-selected E2E, including Git preview and CLI identity tests.
- [ ] SC-02 Protected merge to staging preserves its source history, followed by successful authenticated staging artifact/deployment receipt.
